item.title: INTERSTUDENT 2026
item.description: Best international student in Poland 2026Special Prize Fatih Pekcan (Turkey), a BA Psychology student at SWPS University, has stood out since his first year for his exceptional involvement in academic, organizational, and social activities at the university, including founding the Scientific Society Major Issues in Psychotherapy and Counseling. His original paper describing one of his research projects has received over 1,500 views on ResearchGate.

item.title: INTERSTUDENT 2026
item.description: Best international student in Poland 2026Special Prize Wiktoria Ptak (USA), a fourth-year medical student at the Medical University of Bialystok, was born in Poland, emigrated to the USA, and returned to the country to pursue her studies. She has become a great support for international students thanks to her fluent command of the Polish language. She regularly assists with translations and intervenes in situations where language barriers hinder the learning process or daily life in Poland.

item.title: INTERSTUDENT 2026
item.description: Best international Student in Poland 2026 in the bachelor degree category Emilie Horn (Germany/Brasil), a third-year student of International Business at the Krakow University of Economics, enriches the local academic community and builds real bridges between cultures thanks to her unique path (from Germany, through Brazil, to Poland). She is one of the top students at CUE, with the highest GPA in the International Business program (4.96) and holds the Rector’s Scholarship.
